channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Eleanor Roosevelt — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-18
item.description: “Great minds discuss ideas; average minds discuss events; small minds discuss people.” — Eleanor Roosevelt

item.title: Confucius — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-17
item.description: “What you do not want done to yourself, do not do to others.” — Confucius

item.title: Harry Banks — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-16
item.description: “For success, attitude is equally as important as ability.” — Harry Banks

item.title: Benjamin Disraeli — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-15
item.description: “There is no education like adversity.” — Benjamin Disraeli

item.title: Seneca — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-14
item.description: “No man was ever wise by chance.” — Seneca

item.title: Euclid — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-13
item.description: “Things which are equal to the same thing are also equal to one another.” — Euclid

item.title: Friedrich Nietzsche — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-12
item.description: “Art is the supreme task and the truly metaphysical activity in this life.” — Friedrich Nietzsche

item.title: Gautama Buddha — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-11
item.description: “Your worst enemy cannot harm you as much as your own unguarded thoughts.” — Gautama Buddha
